caption_used: Training loss curves over iterations for Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), and four SepLLM configurations. All models start with loss values exceeding 3.4 and converge as training progresses to 140,000 iterations. The Vanilla model achieves the lowest final loss at approximately 2.45, while StrmLLM (n=64) converges to roughly 2.60, showing a notable gap from the SepLLM variants. Among the SepLLM configurations, the H/T variant reaches the lowest loss at approximately 2.49, with SepLLM (n=128) settling at approximately 2.55, slightly above both the base SepLLM (n=64) and SepLLM (n=64, H) which converge near 2.51-2.52. The most rapid decrease in loss occurs within the first 20,000 iterations for all models, after which convergence slows considerably.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This figure displays training loss curves over iterations for six model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and spans from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and ranges from approximately 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The Vanilla model is shown as a purple solid line, which starts above 3.4 at iteration 0, drops steeply through the first 20,000 iterations, and gradually converges to approximately 2.45 by 140,000 iterations, achieving the lowest final loss among all lines. StrmLLM (n=64) is depicted as a blue solid line that follows a similar steep initial decline but converges to a notably higher final loss of approximately 2.60, remaining clearly separated above the other lines in the latter portion of training. SepLLM (n=64) is shown as an orange solid line that starts above 3.4, decreases rapidly in the early iterations, and converges to approximately 2.51–2.52 by 140,000 iterations. SepLLM (n=64, H) is represented by a green solid line with a very similar trajectory to SepLLM (n=64), converging near 2.51–2.52. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is shown as a red solid line that tracks closely with the Vanilla line and reaches a final loss of approximately 2.49, the lowest among the SepLLM variants. SepLLM (n=128) is depicted as a dark blue solid line that converges to approximately 2.55, positioned between StrmLLM (n=64) and the other SepLLM variants. All six lines exhibit shaded regions around them indicating variability or confidence intervals. The most rapid loss reduction occurs within the first 20,000 iterations for all models, after which the rate of decrease slows considerably and the curves begin to plateau.
